[SWS_DM_02057] Reporting routine control failed to IdsM
Upstream requirements:
RS_Ids_00810
⌈
If a diagnostic service RoutineControl is received, which re-
sults in a negative response, the DM shall report a security event
SEV_UDS_ROUTINE_CONTROL_FAILED to IdsM (see [26] and table
[SWS_DM_02058]) with the context data given in [SWS_DM_02058].
